kroe01.title: Opened With "hey"
kroe01.caption:
You matched, you typed "hey," you hit send. Now what?
Give them something to answer, like a question about their photo.

kroe02.title: The 2 a.m. "u up?"
kroe02.caption:
Is "u up?" at 2 a.m. ever the move?
Send it in daylight with a real plan instead.

kroe03.title: The Six-Paragraph Hello
kroe03.caption:
Six paragraphs before they even said hi?
One line and one question leaves room for them to talk.

kroe04.title: The Cheesy Pickup Line
kroe04.caption:
Pickup lines: cringe or brave?
Corny is fine. Follow it with a real question so they can play along.

kroe05.title: The Four-Minute Voice Note
kroe05.caption:
A four-minute voice note as a first hello?
Keep it short and curious. Ask about something they shared.

kroe06.title: "I Hope This Message Finds You Well"
kroe06.caption:
Opened like a cover letter and wondered why it felt stiff?
A plain "hi" and a fun question works better.

kroe07.title: "You're Gorgeous" (That's It)
kroe07.caption:
"You're gorgeous" and then nothing?
Compliment something they chose, then ask about it.
